20220101.text: Stop! I have orders to search for a wanted criminal!

20220201.text: You! The warrant is for your arrest! Freeze!

20220301.text: Stop! I have orders to search for a wanted criminal!

20220401.text: You! The warrant is for your arrest! Freeze!

401114101.text: Hey Dad, want to play a game of Genius Invokation?

401114102.text: But before we play, I got one thing to say to you! If you're already tipsy from drinking today, then the game will be over in three rounds.

401114103.text: In three rounds? Sounds like you're underestimating your dear father.

401114104.text: I'm pretty sure I could drag the game out to at least five rounds.

401114105.text: Hmph! And you'd still lose! You think that's something to be proud of?

401114106.text: Last time we played, you mistook the Hydro Elemental Dice you rolled for Cryo! Ugh, so annoying!

401114107.text: Haha, you know I have a problem with my eyesight...

401114108.text: No, you have a problem with drinking! Don't try to cover it up!

401114109.text: Alright, alright, I know, drinking is bad. I won't drink today, not even a single drop. There, happy?

401114111.text: Now, if I DO win, what's the prize?

401114112.text: What? You're trying to get me to mix you a drink? Don't you even think about it!

401114113.text: What if I win in under five rounds?

401114114.text: In your dreams, I won't lose! Let's start!

401114201.text: So, you leave for a few days and come back with some serious TCG skills. Care to explain?

401114202.text: I was fortunate enough to have played a match with a skilled opponent.

401114203.text: Oh? And who might that be? Wait, let me try to guess...

401114204.text: Ningguang doesn't have the time for this sort of thing... Hmm, Xiangling and Xinyan aren't usually practicing either...

401114205.text: If Yaoyao were free, she'd be running down to the ship to say hi to everyone, so that rules her out.

401114206.text: #Hah, could it be {NICKNAME}? Did {M#he}{F#she} happen to be in Liyue Harbor?

401114207.text: #Sorry Captain, you still haven't guessed it. But I did happen to see {NICKNAME}, and even forged a new friendship over cards...

401114208.text: Oh, made a new friend, huh? Then I won't be able to guess it.

401114209.text: Yes, I met Hu Tao, director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Have you heard of her?

401114210.text: Yeah, I've heard of her before. Isn't she the one that won the King of Invokations Grand Prix in Liyue?

401114211.text: That's right. She said that she's been an admirer of yours for a long time, and hopes to make your acquaintance one day.

401114212.text: Alright! There isn't a better opportunity!

401114213.text: We'll invite her aboard to play a few matches, and I'll get a taste of playing against a champion.

401114214.text: Oh, speaking of which, perhaps I should go find her personally at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. You know, to show some sincerity.

401114301.text: Hmm? Oh, did you make the trip all the way back here just to see me?

401114303.text: Ah, so that's what you uncovered in the end. Hmm, I'm not quite sure how I feel about that.

401114304.text: But thank you for letting me know.

401114305.text: Hearing how things ended almost feels like reading the end of a light novel. Now we can all rest at ease.

401114401.text: #{NICKNAME}, what a coincidence! Cyno already told me everything that happened.

401114403.text: I'll stop you right there! Cyno has already told me countless jokes with that smug look on his face. I don't want to hear any more.

401114404.text: That's all I have to say on that topic.

401116101.text: Timmie is breezing right through the tournament as if he has the blessing of the Anemo Archon! And now he's one of the favorites to win Mondstadt's regional final!

401116102.text: Little Timmie really is something else. You all should've seen him play against that golden-haired lass, the way he won...

401116103.text: How absurd! Did you not see the plume glowing with holy light on that young boy's back?

401116104.text: Its scorching light must have shackled and blinded the Prinzessin's Auge der Verurteilung and twisted the scales of fate!

401116105.text: I shall bring my faithful retainers from the Immernachtreich, and vengeance shall be mine!

401116106.text: ██y, don't ██ too late. If you see this ██, don't ██ to come back ██ for ██.

401116201.text: Be sure to visit the food stalls next to the tournament grounds, with a variety of snacks sure to please the palate! The Limited Edition Minty Qingxin Cakes are selling out quick!

401116202.text: Do these Minty Qingxin Cakes live up to the hype? I keep coming back but I've never managed to get my hands on one...

401116203.text: New to the tournament venue, huh? Word is that the snack is a favorite among the adepti, so it sold out on the first day.

401116204.text: It does taste refreshing, but it's also just a little bit bitter.

401116206.text: It's so bitter my tongue shriveled.

401116208.text: Ugh, now I'm curious! When's this snack gonna be back on sale? Come on, you're missing out on so much business!

401116209.text: Speaking of the adepti... Do they also play Genius Invokation TCG?

401116210.text: Everyone likes to have fun, right?

401116301.text: In Inazuma's regional final, Guuji Yae Miko of the Grand Narukami Shrine will be facing off against Sangonomiya Kokomi, Divine Priestess of the Sangonomiya Shrine!

401116302.text: Will the imperious crash of thunder make itself heard within the unfathomable deeps?

401116303.text: The revised hardcover version of King of Invokations is now available for purchase at all tournament venues! Free gift of Forbidden Dice with each purchase!

401116305.text: She doesn't have a chance. I'm confident Madam Sangonomiya Kokomi will be the one that emerges victorious.

401116306.text: In your dreams! Why don't you put your money where your mouth is and bet on it?

401116307.text: Bring it on! Loser pays for dinner!

401116308.text: Please abide by the tournament venue's rules and enjoy the tournament in a respectful manner.

401116401.text: The exciting King of Invokations Grand Prix is in full swing! Many outstanding players have emerged from the competiton. Come participate in the duels today!

401116402.text: Huh, I didn't think you building designers could play cards so well. Quite a few players from Kshahrewar made it to the quarterfinals.

401116403.text: What do you mean, "building designers"? We study structural geometry and mechanism theory, and it's MUCH more complex than staring at words all day in Haravatat.

401116404.text: "Staring at words all day"? You should try "staring at words" a bit, maybe then you'd learn to write! Linguistics and Rune Studies are both extremely profound fields of knowledge.

401116405.text: Everyone has their specialties. But since nobody is willing to yield, why don't we organize an Interdarshan Invokation Championship?

401116408.text: I'll see you at the tournament!

705310201.text: I can't mess up the Guild's assignment...

705310202.text: Wh—Whoa! How many Scenic Checkpoints have you found? Anyway, I wish you the best of luck!

705320201.text: Traveler, are you here to try Zero Hour Invokation?

705320302.text: No problem! Please select the cards you'd like to use.

705320303.text: Oh, and your opponent will be... Let's see... Many players enter the contest using nicknames, and some of them are pretty hard to remember...

705320304.text: Here it is! Your opponent will be Cheerful Torchbearer. Once you're prepared, you may begin anytime.

705320401.text: I've got other things to do right now...

705320402.text: That's alright. Zero Hour Invokation isn't just a one-day event.

705320403.text: You're welcome to come take part anytime during the Grand Prix event period.

705320501.text: So you're the one I'll be playing against! It's a real competition this time, so you'd better be ready!

705320504.text: Okay! I need to go over my deck one more time, and if things don't work out... I guess I'll have to ask someone for advice.

705320701.text: Whoa... You're so much better than everyone I've played against...

705321201.text: The King of Invokations Grand Prix sure has attracted a lot of people...

705321202.text: Hey there, Traveler. Are you here to take part in the Grand Prix as well?

705321302.text: Oh, you're interested in trying this out? Sure, you can build your deck over here.

705321303.text: You'll be playing against Hong'yu. Good luck!

705321304.text: I never expected Zero Hour Invokation to be so popular... Hmm, I think I'm sensing some business opportunities...

705321305.text: Ahem! Please build your deck here and let me know if you need any help.

705321402.text: Mechanical paintings? Oh, you mean those paintings you can freely take apart and reassemble?

705321403.text: They're right over here. The Guild brought them over not long ago.

705321404.text: If you're interested, you can give them a try right away.

705321501.text: Seems like you'll be playing against me this time... Great! I was just looking for a worthy opponent.

705321504.text: A decisive victory is rather difficult to achieve in this tournament.

705321601.text: *sigh* Turns out I couldn't just place all of my trust in the guide...

705321701.text: You truly were a worthy opponent.

705321901.text: I've got other things to do right now...

705321902.text: Alright. I'll be at this booth throughout the Grand Prix event period.

705321903.text: If you have any questions, just come ask me directly.

705322201.text: The theme isn't bad, but as for the plot... I wonder if it's good enough...

705322202.text: Ah, Traveler! My apologies. I got distracted for a moment thinking about light novels...

705322203.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

705322302.text: Oh, that's right, I'm the one in charge of Zero Hour Invokation. Are you here to play?

705322303.text: You're welcome to build your deck here. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask me.

705322304.text: Your opponent Secchu Tou is ready to begin. You may start the match anytime once you're prepared.

705322402.text: Mr. Félix's mechanical paintings are right over here! Oh, what intricate works of art... Even I have tried them many times myself.

705322403.text: It's such a pleasure to enjoy works like these...

705322404.text: Ah, I'm sorry... Let's get back to the topic.

705322405.text: If you're interested in trying the mechanical paintings, you should head over and take a look.

705322501.text: We're in a real competition, so please don't feel obliged to go easy on me.

705322504.text: I'll be looking into building a more optimal deck. It's a formal competition after all, and I shouldn't make a fool of myself.

705322601.text: Phew... I really was beaten by the best.

705322701.text: Were you distracted during our match? Hehe, I could tell.

705322901.text: I've got other things to do right now...

705322902.text: That's alright, I won't be going anywhere for a while. I have a job to do after all...

705322903.text: If you're interested in trying Zero Hour Invokation, you're welcome to find me anytime.

705323201.text: Genius Invokation TCG and mechanical paintings... Do these two have anything in common at all?

705323302.text: Oh? You're interested in Zero Hour Invokation?

705323303.text: No problem, please build your deck here. If you have any other questions, just ask me anytime.

705323304.text: We have a player called "Revived Serval" currently waiting for an opponent.

705323305.text: You may begin once you're ready.

705323402.text: The mechanisms crafted by that Fontaine man? I placed them over there.

705323403.text: Me? I'm not interested in mechanisms and the like, so I haven't taken a closer look at them.

705323404.text: If you're interested, though, feel free to check them out.

705323501.text: Whoa... There are so many players crowded around... Uhh, I'm getting kinda nervous...

705323504.text: You're leaving? Uh, me? I'm gonna meet up with Master. Where were we supposed to meet again...

705323601.text: I—I've never been in a situation like that before...

705323701.text: I finally won! Looks like my trip here wasn't in vain after all.

705323902.text: Oh? You're interested in Zero Hour Invokation?

705323903.text: No problem, please build your deck here. If you have any other questions, just ask me anytime.

705324101.text: You look like you're raring to go... Let's get started then.

705324104.text: There are so many people participating in this tournament, my ears are starting to hurt... ugh.

705324201.text: Color me impressed. It looks like you came well-prepared.

705324301.text: Don't be discouraged. I may have won this time, but you can always try to win the next round.

705324401.text: I've got other things to do right now...

705324402.text: Sure, you go ahead. I'll be here throughout the King of Invokations Grand Prix.

705324403.text: If you ever feel like playing Zero Hour Invokation, just come find me here. I'll get everything prepared.

705330201.text: Ah, Traveler, it's you. Would you like to try this painting out?

705330203.text: Haha, great! I'm sure you'll solve this mechanical painting in no time.

705330204.text: The mechanical painting's over here. You may begin whenever you're ready.

705330206.text: Uh... okay then. Feel free to stop by when you get the chance! I won't be going anywhere for the time being...

705340201.text: Traveler, would you like to try Heart of the Dice?

705340203.text: No problem. Um, have you finished reading the rulebook yet?

705340204.text: Oh, it's fine, you don't have to read it cover to cover to play. You can always learn as you play.

705340206.text: You're busy? Alright then, feel free to come find me anytime. This booth will be here throughout the King of Invokations Grand Prix event period.
